name: indie-odyssey
description: G6 cart port from examples/indie-odyssey — Echoes of the Shardgrid, a cross-backend dungeon crawler with GLB enemies and a story-mode intro.
author: Nova64
notes:
Initial Godot port. Cart code uses nova64.* namespaced API throughout and runs against the QuickJS bridge unchanged. Known limitations on the Godot host (pending follow-up work):

  - Story-mode slides use document.createElement('canvas') for the overlay. The Godot host has no DOM; story playback will need a Godot-native VideoLayer or a 2D framebuffer fallback. See nova64.story for the replacement API once Godot adapter exists.
  - Combat sprite overlay (combatSpriteCanvas) likewise uses DOM. Sprite fallback will need to route through the cart framebuffer until Godot host implements an HTMLCanvas-equivalent.
  - Combat skybox plane uses globalThis.THREE.MeshBasicMaterial directly — guarded by a feature check, so it no-ops on Godot. nova64.light.createSolidSkybox is the cross-backend path and works.

  Assets total ~26MB (GLBs + story images + sprite sheets). PACKAGED_ASSET_BASE = 'assets/' is the canonical layout — resolveAssetBase() in code.js falls through to it whenever globalThis.nova64.assets reports the bundled normal.jpg present.
